integrity: Exact finite Prüfer/isomorphism enumeration and rational full-state checks are supplementary to the independent symbolic proof using support-overlap cumulants. Scientific priority provisional; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous independent vertex survival on finite trees only; no applicability theorem for loopy networks, heterogeneous extinction, or correlated habitat occupancy; uniqueness of topology does not follow from the third cumulant.
title: Six-patch threshold and degree-assortativity law for fragmentation skewness on trees
